title: System health
description: Database, scheduled jobs, message queue, e-mail, PDF, AI, storage, audit chain and certificates of this installation.

job.name: Job
job.recentFailures: {{failures24h}} failed run(s) in the last 24 hours.

common.timedOut: The check did not answer within {{seconds}} seconds.

database.ok: PostgreSQL {{version}} answered in {{latencyMs}} ms; database size {{sizeBytes}}.
database.slow: PostgreSQL {{version}} answered slowly ({{latencyMs}} ms); database size {{sizeBytes}}.

migrations.ok: All {{schemas}} schemas are up to date.
migrations.pending: {{count}} migration(s) not applied — run the upgrade (--migrate).

scheduler.stopped: The scheduler is not running: reminders, escalations and e-mails are not sent.
scheduler.schedulesOff: Running, but scheduled runs are switched off (Scheduling:RunSchedules = false).

outbox.dead: {{dead}} message(s) failed permanently — re-queue them in Settings → Scheduled jobs.
outbox.late: The oldest message has waited {{oldestPendingMinutes}} minutes ({{pending}} waiting): notifications are late.

email.notConfigured: No e-mail server is configured: no e-mails are sent.
email.ok: {{host}}:{{port}} — {{sent24h}} e-mail(s) sent in the last 24 hours.
email.idle: {{host}}:{{port}} — no e-mails in the last 24 hours.
email.someFailed: {{host}}:{{port}} — {{failed24h}} failed and {{sent24h}} sent in the last 24 hours.
email.lastFailed: {{host}}:{{port}} — the last e-mail failed ({{lastAt}}). Use Send test e-mail in Settings → Email server.

pdf.unreachable: Gotenberg cannot be reached: PDF exports and reports fail.

ai.noProvider: AI is on but its default provider is missing or inactive.
ai.someFailed: {{provider}} — {{failed24h}} of {{calls24h}} call(s) failed in the last 24 hours.
ai.lastFailed: {{provider}} — the last call failed ({{lastError}}). Use Test connection in Settings → AI.

ocr.offInstalled: Text recognition is off; the engine is installed ({{languages}}).
ocr.offMissing: Text recognition is off; the engine or its languages ({{languages}}) are not installed.
ocr.missing: Text recognition is on but Tesseract or its languages ({{languages}}) are missing: scanned documents cannot be read.

storage.notWritable: Files cannot be written ({{provider}}): uploads fail.

auditChain.never: The audit chain has not been verified yet (daily job, or Audit → Verify).
auditChain.stale: Last verified {{at}} — more than 48 hours ago.
auditChain.broken: Verification on {{at}} found a break at entry {{brokenSeq}}: open Audit → Verify.

dataProtection.ok: {{keys}} key(s); the current key is valid until {{expiresAt}}.
dataProtection.noCurrentKey: No valid key ({{keys}} stored): sessions and stored secrets cannot be protected.

certificates.attention: A certificate expires soon, has expired or cannot be read.

salesforceSync.primary: This system is primary: {{source}} is not being synced (outage open).
salesforceSync.failed: The last sync run from {{source}} failed. Open Settings → Integrations → Salesforce sync for the run log.
salesforceSync.late: No sync run from {{source}} succeeded within the expected time.
salesforceSync.exceptions: Last successful sync {{at}}; {{exceptions}} open exceptions to review.
salesforceSync.ok: Last successful sync {{at}}; no open exceptions.
